title: MightyMeals Support | Ticket Received 148169
description:
Hi Esther, 

 Thanks for reaching out to MightyMeals Customer Support! Just wanted to drop you a quick note to let you know we've got your message, and we're on it! 

 Our team will be diving into your request and will get back to you ASAP. But if you're in a pinch and need help right away, don't hesitate to give us a call during our regular business hours at the number below. 

 By the way, have you checked out our FAQs yet? You can find them by clicking the Help option on our website or through the menu if you're on mobile. 

 Now, we totally understand that some things like missed deadlines or cancellations can be a bummer. Our meals are made-to-order, so at 12:01 AM after a deadline, our kitchen crew is already hard at work making your meals, so we can't make changes at that point. Be sure to plan ahead and pick a delivery date that works best for you! 

 Thanks again for getting in touch with us. We're here to make your MightyMeals experience as smooth as possible, and we can't wait to get everything sorted for you!  

 Best regards, 
 The MightyMeals Team 
 (833) 40-MEALS
